From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alexei Popov <a.popov@novatek.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & capacity addendum - redlines attached

Marcus / Jonas — reviewing Novateks redlines now. Preliminary legal positions below (high level, not yet final):

1) Data retention & training clause:
- We can accommodate a strict non-training clause, but that requires them to accept a Private deployment (VPC) or a contractual data segregation commitment plus a small surcharge for the isolation guarantee.
- If they remain on Hosted, propose a compromise: 90-day logs retention + explicit prohibition on use of customer-provided prompt/content for model training unless customer opts in.

2) SLA credit removal:
- We do not accept blanket removal of remedy mechanics. Propose amending the credit mechanism to: (a) exclude transitory spikes caused by force majeure/cloud provider outage; (b) include a modest cap on aggregate credits per quarter. That typically satisfies legal and customers who fear over-crediting.

3) Order form and pricing tables:
- Ensure order form includes a clear definition of what constitutes a "token" for billing and an overage ladder.

Questions for commercial team (Jonas):
- Do we have flexibility to offer a 6% incremental discount on committed uplift if Novatek commits 12 months?

Ill prepare suggested language for the data/training and SLA clauses and send a redlined MSA fragment by EOD Monday.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Alexei Popov <a.popov@novatek.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@novatek.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 14:12:00 +01:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & capacity addendum - redlines attached

Lauren — appreciate the quick read. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Novatek will accept Private deployment only if we can keep the same latency SLA and Redwood can support AWS us-east-1 pop; otherwise we will remain on Hosted and require the non-training covenant in contract. We cannot pay significant surcharge for VPC.
- For retention: we can accept 365 days if Redwood confirms encryption-at-rest and access audit logs can be exported on request.
- SLA credits: we can accept the capped-credit compromise but need the cap to be no less than 5% of monthly invoice (else its not meaningful for us).

Ive attached a revised order form with our counter redlines (Novatek_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx) and inline notes. Also flagged a billing contact change.

Attachment: Novatek_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Can your commercial/legal team confirm position on the 5% cap and whether 365-day retention + exportable audit logs is acceptable?

Thanks,
Alexei

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alexei Popov <a.popov@novatek.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & capacity addendum - redlines attached

Alexei — thanks for the detail and the updated order form. Commercial confirmation: we can meet the requested +100k committed tokens and offer the following pricing options (all USD / monthly):

Option A: 12-mo commitment (preferred) — committed tier with 6% uplift discount on the additional 100k line; overage billed at 1.25x committed rate
Option B: 3-mo rolling — higher committed rate (no discount), overage billed at 1.5x

On the SLA cap: we cannot uncap credits beyond a reasonable threshold. Legal and finance are comfortable with a quarterly cap equivalent to 5% of the monthly invoice (as a maximum aggregate credit), but wed like to phrase it as "aggregate credits for any calendar quarter shall not exceed 5% of the total invoice for that quarter." That should keep it quantifiable.

DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/en/novatek-rnw-draft (internal link)

Next steps: Lauren will send exact MSA clause language; once we have Novatek confirmation on retention + training-use language and which pricing option, Ill populate the order form and route for signature.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Director, Commercial | Redwood Inference
